itemListElement.name: Welder Qualification Validity: Continuity, Expiry and Revalidation

@graph.headline: Welder Qualification Validity: Continuity, Expiry and Revalidation
@graph.description: How long a welder qualification stays valid: the ISO 9606-1 six-month confirmation, the three revalidation routes, ASME Section IX's six-month expiry rule — and how to keep track across a whole floor.

mainEntity.name: How long is an ISO 9606-1 welder certificate valid?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the revalidation route chosen when it was issued: three years with a retest, two years renewable with tested production welds, or open-ended under an ISO 3834-2/-3 quality system. On every route, the six-month confirmation must also be kept up.
The person responsible for welding activities at the employer — typically the welding coordinator — or the examiner or examining body. It is a documented confirmation, not a retest.

mainEntity.name: Does an ASME welder qualification expire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only through non-use: if the welder doesn't weld with a process for six months, the qualification for that process expires (QW-322.1). It can be renewed with a single test coupon (QW-322.2).

mainEntity.name: Can software decide whether a welder is qualified?

acceptedAnswer.text: It shouldn't. Good software keeps the records, runs the clocks and warns you in time. Whether a welder is qualified for a job is a judgement for a qualified person, who signs it.
